title: AGUA FINITA | The Finite Water City
summary: A whole-site network of four conditional towns, productive energy/compute corridors and an eastern gateway grows only with verified water. Fixed pilot fields and the existing first living quarter remain unchanged. The detailed first neighbourhood is one phase of the regional city, not the entire proposal.

autonomy.human_role: Human selected Finite Water City and the three nodes, confirmed jingyuanhuang-design / Jingyuan Huang, requested clearer overall layout, reviewed the V2 diagrams, and then explicitly requested public publication on 2026-10-25. Codex authored geometry, calculations, text and visuals. Public preview publication is authorised; formal competition entry awaits the organiser opening submissions. The new V2 walking spine and arrival point remain explicitly identified proposals. On 2026-10-26 the human requested a whole-site redesign under the updated brief, questioned the excessive flood reserve depiction and directed Codex to revise only this entry while other agents handle repository rules. V3 distinguishes flood screening from permanent restrictions. The human has not yet reviewed the integrated V3 package. Human requested a complete design argument with plans, sections, diagrams and massing rather than a six-page digest; authorised uploading the completed revision and replacing its abstract cover with a city rendering. V6 adopts the updated main/technical presentation contract and discloses unfinished engineering independently. On 2026-10-27 the human rejected V7's miniature all-functions town and asked to continue with continuous residential districts and separately justified production. V7 is withdrawn from recommendation. V8 is a district-structure review in reviews/district-structure-v8, not a ready submission; older core geometry and imagery are retained as history pending a full rebuild.

nodes_reason: B03 tests whether production can accept water limits; C03 gives floods room; A03 tests whether daily public life survives heat without decorative irrigation.

tradeoff.objective: Maximum uninterrupted compute throughput and minimum cooling electricity
tradeoff.why: Scarce water is reserved first for people and the existing agricultural system.
tradeoff.consequence: Dry cooling raises hot-hour electricity demand; interruptible compute loses saleable hours. Imported electricity receives no unverified carbon-free credit.
tradeoff.who_bears: Compute investors and customers accept interruption contracts; tenants are protected by reserved service funding, while workers need paid reassignment during curtailment.

thesis: The city grows only when its water ledger can support another complete neighbourhood.
render_note: A low-rise desert settlement of pale mineral plaster and aggregate; dry gravel washes, modest drip planting, shade roofs and arcades. Existing pilot untouched.
render_rules: Preserve footprints, storeys, street positions, camera and terrain. No lakes, ornamental canals, lawns, skyscrapers or lush forest. All images are concept illustrations.
